marco: Quick poll: low-key weekend — pick one or react

marco: A) Morning ceramics drop-in + coffee 
marco: B) Night market + live jazz (small venue) 
marco: C) Coast tidepooling + picnic (carpool?) 
marco: D) Full-on nap 😴

marco: react with :one:/:two:/:three:/:four: or drop a comment. if you pick C, say if you can drive.

sasha: :one: for sure — I've been wanting to try handbuilding. anyone know if tools provided?

owen: :three: I can drive 2 ppl. how early for tidepools? low tide's at 9am.

lucy: :two: for the jazz — are there tickets? link?

devin: @lucy here's the event page: https://tiny.events/shore-market-jazz — $12 at the door.

sasha: @marco I checked — studio provides basic tools and 1 firing. bring an apron.

rahul: :four: — I will defend my nap schedule. also taking cookies if anyone needs snack fuel for the coast.

calendar-bot: Added a tentative 'Coast tidepool + picnic' event to #events for Sun 09:00. (auto)

marco: Nice! Looks like A and B are tied atm. Owen said he can drive for C. If you want A, meet at 9am at Bluebird Studio. If C, meet at 8:15 at office parking to load gear.

lucy: If enough people want jazz, i'll grab a few tix online.

devin: I'll bring a bluetooth speaker for the picnic (battery fully charged).

sasha: also can bring extra mitts for tidepooling if needed.

marco: sweet. i'll compile final headcount by Sat 3pm. drop prefs or swap reactions. :v:
